notes.title: New Year's update 1.6.8
notes.content:
☃❄🎄 Dear friends, Kremlingames wishes you a Happy New Year 2024! During this year we've had a lot of things happen, from the changing design of our game studio to the announcement of the long-awaited Crisis in the Kremlin: The Cold War. In the new year we wish you happiness, success in all your endeavours, only bright streaks in your life, and fewer obstacles, which we are sure you will jump over! May the new year fulfil all your expectations and be better than all the previous ones! Happy holidays to you, dear friends, happy new year!

🎄🎄🎉🎁 And of course, what's a new year without gifts? So, in honour of the holiday, Kremlingames is giving all owners of the game "China: Mao's legacy" a free update, which we hope will make you happy! The update will include the following:

1. The ability to pit Brezhnev's circle against each other and change the balance of power
2. An opportunity to bring Richard Kosolapov to power
3. Four new endings for the USSR 3.
4. Four new achievements
5. New starting modifiers
6. New solution
7. Added the ability to invite Libya into an economic alliance
8. Reworked the conditions for d'Estaing and Chirac to win the elections
9. Added the possibility to support Solidarity in Poland
10. New endings in Yugoslavia (Taking into account the USSR membership in NATO / pressed Visegrad under Gorby in the USSR / pro-Soviet SFRY).
11. Restalinisation and Ethiopia events now do not require China's absence from CMEA
12. India agrees to compromise on disputed territories if helped to right or left wing
13. The text of the ending of the unified GDR has been reworked
14. Mongolia's neutral status is now taken into account in review and outcomes
15. Mongolia's buttons do not disappear if it is in the OVD and China in the Soviet blocs
16. Inviting European countries into the alliance does not take away, but adds to party loyalty

Once again, congratulations to everyone on the coming new year!
Regards, indie studio Kremlingames

notes.title: Update 1.6. "The Fallen Eagle"
notes.content:
Dear friends, we are also releasing a free update to 1.6. which includes:

1. Each politician has been given a parameter of their desired position. And if a politician does not hold this position (and does not hold a position higher in rank), he will start disliking the person who has this position. Similarly, trying to remove a politician from his favourite position (without moving to a higher rank) will result in a drastic drop in loyalty to the ruler, while assigning him to his favourite position (if he did not hold a position higher than the rank) will result in a moderate increase in the politician's loyalty to the ruler.
2. The formula for attacking politicians against each other has been changed: now the formula for defensive potential takes into account the position held, and politicians from serious positions cannot simply be removed in a conspiracy, they are first removed from office and their influence is significantly reduced. 
3. When hovering over a politician, a pop-up now appears with information about what position the politician wishes to hold, what their exact relationship to the player is, and how old they are.
4. When hovering over the economic section of the contribution, a popup appears with information about what the impact of the contribution is (without exact numbers).
5. The Sandbox difficulty mode now supplies the player with more money and agents.
